HVO standby gensets: 105 MW ÷ 2.75 MW per unit = 38.2 → 39 units; 39 units form 4 blocks (block size 10); N+1 adds 4; total 43 units (118 MW).
Fuel storage: 105 MW × 48 h × 0.26 L/kWh = 1,311 m³ (1,101 t).
BESS: 25 % of design facility load 113 MW = 28.3 MW × 2 h = 56.5 MWh; role peak-shave against grid cap; size kept as given.
Rooftop PV: roof 27,500 m² = 27,500 m² free × 50 % usable ÷ 5.5 m²/kWp = 2.50 MWp.
Offsite PPA (hybrid): 100 % of each year's facility consumption (steady state ≈ 791,905 MWh/yr), delivered over the grid connection and capped by import capacity.
Grid connection: offered import capacity per period (20.0 MW → 120 MW), the same for every option and never resized. Connection capex on 120 MW at full connection (HV band, AIS).
Grid shortfall at design load, months 23–29: design load 27.1 MW less 0.0 MW firm on site less 20.0 MW grid leaves up to 7.1 MW; dispatched as unmet load under "Show unmet load".

Grid cable route: 10 m from the POC (default: the access point, standing in for the road side; replace with the real POC) to the buildable envelope, straight line, × €1.50 m/km = €15,000 (in the grid connection capex).
